technique_name: Develop a set of criteria for judging the quality of a health food.
description: When evaluating the quality of a health food, the following criteria should be taken into consideration: ingredients, nutritional content, taste, texture, preparation instructions, freshness, target demographic, cost, convenience, reviews and recommendations from health experts and nutritionists, sustainability of the food source, and health benefits.
